stories.title: Two Palestinians wounded in Israeli raid near Nablus, settlers and troops storm towns in Ramallah and Jenin
stories.summary: Two Palestinians wounded in Israeli raid near Nablus, settlers and troops storm towns in Ramallah and Jenin Two people have been wounded by Israeli forces during a military raid on the town of Beit Furik, east of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, Wafa news agency is reporting, citing medical sources. According to the report, the director of the Ambulance and Emergency Center at the Red Crescent in Nablus, Dean Ahmed, said medical teams treated two Palestinians who were wounded after being assaulted by Israeli soldiers.
